Relevant documentary evidence in this regard shall be uploaded along with the bid in respect of the offered product or service. Ground of Defense of India. 2. Conflict of Interest 3. Bid Security Declaration (for bidders claiming MSE preference/EMD exemption) 4. EMD Payment Details (if Applicable) 5. Terms & Condition acceptance in bidders letter head 6. Product Specifications acceptance as per BL requirement 7. Product/ Technical Data sheet of offered material. Note: A. BL reserves the right to request for samples/ Product Data Sheet/ Technical specifications of the offered product to enable BL to check and confirm the specifications of the products offered by all/specific bidders as and when found necessary. B. Vendor must provide necessary confirmation from OEM regarding any information / clarification as and when required by BL on the product. C. Delivery period being 15 days from the date of each Call-up - An official call-up will be issued by the Kolkata Plant through email after the award of the contract as per t he requirements. The successful bidder must ensure that the material for each call-up is delivered to the r espective Plant within 15 days from the date of issuance of that call-up. Each lot/batch should be accompa nied by the manufacturer’s test certificate and approval of quality report. If the bidder fails to deliver the material within 15 days from the date of call-up, Liquidated Damages (LD) at the rate of 0.5% per week, subject to a maximum of 5%, shall be applicable. The total Contract Period shall be 60 days. Delivery Address: G&L Kolkata: Balmer Lawrie & Co Ltd, Grease Division, P-43, Hide Road Extension, Kolkata -700088 D. Call-up Quantity: The quantity under each call-up shall be between 2,000 kg to 2,500 kg. An y material delivered without email confirmation/ call up or with a quantity greater than mentio ned in callup, may not be accepted at plant and bidder will have to take the material back. No request from bidder in this concern shall be entertained by any of the Balmer Lawrie officials. E. Packing: Packaging in barrels, following details are also to be marked on the barrels: a) Product Name b) Name & Address of manufacturer c) Batch No & date d) Gross, Tare & net weight e) Any other details as specified in the contract. F. Risk Purchase Clause will be applicable.

Risk Purchase: Without prejudice to other provisions in the bid, in the event of the supplier failing to suppl y within the stipulated lead time as per our call up/ PO or Contract date, Balmer Lawrie shall have the optio n to procure the product from alternate sources, at the risk and cost of the supplier without further intimati on. In case of rejection, if any, dispatch of replacement material for domestic suppliers and effecting shipment for overseas suppliers, is to be made within one week of intimation failing which BL shall have right to proc ure the product from alternate sources at the risk and cost of the supplier without further intimation. . 15.
